programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Ismael Concha es trasladado de urgencias para prestarle atención médica. La fiscal evita que Marcela Lievano ingiera el vaso de agua. Marcela confronta a Priscila y dice que todos son corruptos.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Marcela sigue haciendo exigencias para dar la información que conduzca a la captura de León Jaramillo y de Vanegas. Una última petición es estar en el operativo de captura.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El presidente ha dado la orden de eliminar a Pedro Pablo porque teme que lo delate en sus operaciones ilícitas. Perrys rescata a Pedro Pablo y Tato. Bruna, bella asesina, y "Burro", sicario, se unen.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Isabel y Julieta son arrestadas. Pedro Pablo las quiere rescatar y considera entregarse. Blanco da la orden de eliminarlo; lo considera un peligro si lo delata. El Capo le declara la guerra.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El Capo llama al capitán Arango para entregarse y hacer un acuerdo. Marcela abandona el país. Los narcos mexicanos y la policía atacan al Capo y él logra huir. Isabel y Julieta son extraditadas.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Perrys vuelve con Yolanda, le lleva dinero a la mamá de Marcela. Perrys contará su historia para el libro "Las Mujeres de El Capo". Blanco paga 100 millones de dólares al Capo para que no lo delate.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El Burro ve a su mamá para entregarle el dinero que le dio el Capo. Los mexicanos amenazan con matar a su mamá y hermana si no entrega al Capo. Blanco ordena le pongan un cinturón bomba a Burro.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El Capo, Bruna, Perrys y Tato, ven llegar a Burro les avisa que trae una bomba y evita que explote. En enfrentamiento con los mexicanos Perrys muere en brazos de Pedro Pablo por salvar su vida.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El Capo salva a una mujer de ser violada, al entregar a los sujetos dirá a la policía quien la salvó. El Capo y su gente encuentran refugio. El Capo decide regar las cenizas de Perrys en el mar.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Blanco decide arrojar el dinero al mar en Tolú. Todo listo para el secuestro del hijo del Presidente. Agendado llamamiento a juicio de la esposa e hija del Capo en EEUU. El Presidente preocupado.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Pedro Pablo, Tato, Bruna y Burro logran escapar de la ciudad. El abogado Rubén Castro tiene su primer encuentro con Isabel y Julieta. Buscará trasladen a un mejor lugar a Julieta por su embarazo.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Priscilla informa a Velandia que el Capo no está muerto y enloquece. Pedro Pablo y su gente llegan a Tolú para recoger el dinero, los lancheros atacan, Bruna los salva. Se entera del juicio en EEUU.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: Todos se reúnen en El Paso. Tato suplanta al nuevo sacerdote, podrán esconder el dinero en la iglesia. Julieta ha sido trasladada a un hospital para evitar contratiempos. Pedro Pablo besa a Bruna.

programme.title: El capo
programme.desc: El juicio de Isabel y Julieta es aplazado. El Paso, Tato se instala en la iglesia y con Pedro esconden el dinero dentro de los Santos. En Bogotá continúan con el secuestro del hijo del Presidente.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Jose Benavidez Jr
programme.desc: On October 13th, 2018, Terence Crawford fought Jose Benavidez Jr for the WBO World Welterweight Title in Omaha, Nebraska. In a dominant performance, Crawford showed out in front of his hometown, delivering a TKO in the final round.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Julius Indongo
programme.desc: On August 19th, 2017 Terence Crawford fought Julius Indongo for the IBF, WBA, WBC and WBO World Super Lightweight titles at the Pinnacle Bank Arena in Lincoln the bout ended in the third round by knockout securing the victory for Crawford.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Kell Brook
programme.desc: On November 14th, 2020 Terence Crawford battled Kell Brook for the WBO World Welterweight title in The Bubble at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas resulting in a fourth round technical knockout victory for Crawford.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Shawn Porter
programme.desc: On November 20th, 2021, Terence Crawford fought Shawn Porter for the WBO World Welterweight Title at the Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas. In a very close fight, Crawford turned it up and put on the pressure late, delivering a TKO in the 10th round.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Thomas Dulorme
programme.desc: On April 18th, 2015, Terence Crawford fought Thomas Dulorme for the WBO World Super Lightweight Title in Arlington, Texas. Putting on the pressure and showing his aggressive style, Crawford scored three knockdowns in the sixth round to get the TKO.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Viktor Postol
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2016, Terence Crawford fought Viktor Postol for the WBO and WBC World Super Lightweight Titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Scoring two knockdowns, Crawford dominated the fight, earning a much deserved unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Yuriorkis Gamboa
programme.desc: On June 28th, 2014, Terence Crawford fought Yuriorkis Gamboa for the WBO Lightweight Title at Century Link Center in Omaha. In Top Rank's 2014 Fight of the Year, Terence Crawford shined in front of his hometown, stopping Gamboa in the ninth round.

programme.title: Thomas Hearns vs Juan Domingo Roldan
programme.desc: On October 29th, 1987 Thomas Hearns faced Juan Domingo Roldan for the vacant WBC World Middleweight title at the Las Vegas Hilton the 12 round bout went only 4 rounds ending with a knockout by Hearns securing the victory.

programme.title: Thomas Hearns vs Roberto Duran
programme.desc: On June 15th, 1984 Thomas Hearns fought Roberto Duran for WBC World Super Welterweight title at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas that resulted in a technical knockout victory in the second round by Hearns.

programme.title: Timothy Bradley Jr vs Kendall Holt
programme.desc: On April 4th, 2009, Timothy Bradley Jr fought Kendall Holt for the WBC and WBO Light Welterweight Titles at the Bell Centre in Montreal. Holt scored two knockdowns to keep the fight close, but Bradley stayed aggressive enough to earn the decision.

programme.title: Timothy Bradley Jr vs Ruslan Provodnikov
programme.desc: On March 16th, 2013, Timothy Bradley fought Ruslan Provodnikov for the WBO Welterweight Title in Carson, California. Provodnikov put up a very strong challenge in an incredible fight, but Bradley prevailed, earning a unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Timothy Bradley vs Manny Pacquiao I
programme.desc: On June 9th, 2012 Manny Pacquiao and Timothy Bradley started their trilogy at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas in a battle for the WBO World Welterweight title that ended in a split decision win for Timothy Bradley.

programme.title: Todd Foster vs Jeff Mayweather
programme.desc: On August 6th, 1992 Todd Foster fought Jeff Mayweather at Denton Field in Miles City with Mayweather going down in rounds 7 & 8 the bout resulted in a technical knockout victory for Foster.

programme.title: Tommy Morrison vs George Foreman
programme.desc: On June 7th, 1993 Tommy Morrison battled George Foreman for the WBO world heavyweight title at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas with Foreman getting a point deducted in round ten the bout resulted in a victory for Morrison.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Deontay Wilder 3
programme.desc: On October 9th, 2021, Tyson Fury fought Deontay Wilder in their third and final matchup against each other at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. In a thrilling fight, Fury once again proved his dominance, defeating Wilder by an 11th-round TKO.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Dillian Whyte
programme.desc: On April 23rd, 2022 Tyson Fury fought Dillian Whyte for the WBC World Heavyweight title at Wembley Stadium Whyte suffered injuries throughout the fight causing the fight to end by technical knockout in the 4th round giving the bout to Fury.

programme.desc: 'S39/E8 - Sandwich Smorgasbord'. Guy Fieri has a sandwich extravaganza with awesome brisket au jus in Indianapolis, tender barbacoa in California and pastrami pizza in San Antonio.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S40/E1 - Fistful Of Flavor'. Guy Fieri grabs fistfuls of flavour at a Mediterranean spot in California, a beachy bistro in New Jersey and an Argentine joint in Indianapolis.

programme.desc: 'S40/E2 - From Breakfast To The Boot'. Guy Fieri hits up a brunch bonanza in Columbus, Ohio, elevated eats in Boston and a taste of Italy in San Luis Obispo, California.

programme.desc: 'S19/E3 - Sweet & Savory: Knoxville Pt 1'. In Knoxville, TN, six teams sell to game day crowds at the University of Tennessee before serving a more refined crowd at the Rossini Opera Festival.

programme.desc: 'S15/E7 - Bread-y, Buttery Family Feast'. Molly Yeh hosts a big, bread-y, buttery family feast with spiced ham, pillowy rolls, savoury stuffing and a smooth, silky pie for dessert.

programme.desc: 'S37/E11 - Oh, The Pasta-bilities!'. Antonia Lofaso and comedian Jay Pharoah recruit pasta pros Sasha Grumman and Zach Chancey to bring the heat against Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E12 - Napa-ing On The Job'. Michael Symon and comedian Manon Mathews cheer on chefs Erin Miller and Stephen Coe, while Bobby Flay is greeted with a familiar face.

programme.title: Bobby Flay's The Line
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Leah Cohen: Pig & Khao'. Longtime 'Beat Bobby Flay' judge Leah Cohen challenges Bobby Flay's home team chefs to a Southeast Asian showdown.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S8/E3 - Smoothie Operators'. Four young chefs try to impress guest judge Jessica Alba. Appetizers include beef tongue and the entree basket pairs an orange smoothie with savoury favourites.

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: 'S6/E1 - Santa's Buddy Movie'. The first three teams of cake, sugar and cookie artists create a scene depicting what it would look like if Santa starred in a buddy adventure movie.

programme.title: Kids Sweets Showdown
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Extreme Cake Adventures'. Kid baking teams are tasked with creating a cupcake cake to illustrate an adventure theme: wild jungle, undersea adventures or space odyssey.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Hat Tricks'. To earn a spot in the finale, the sibling bakers make 'The Cat in the Hat' helper desserts with an animal character who brings joy to children.

programme.title: Didi
programme.desc: Director Sean Wang gives us a candid look at being a teenager. Follow 13-year-old Chris Wang as he navigates his identity, first love, friendships, and family life during the summer of 2008.

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: A group of rescued refugees becomes prey in this thrilling horror. After their boat capsizes, the group's saviours reveal their true intentions and turn into manhunters.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's tale of a deadly and seemingly unstoppable man-eating shark saw this deep-sea horror win three Academy Awards and saw fans returning to watch this cult classic.

programme.title: Saw X
programme.desc: The tenth film in the horror franchise, with Tobin Bell returning. Set between the events of SAW I and II, John Kramer plots his twisted revenge on the doctors who conned him.

programme.title: Hide And Seek
programme.desc: A suspenseful, intense psychological thriller. A man seeking his missing brother is thrust into a dark underworld that threatens his family and sanity.

programme.title: Monolith
programme.desc: A gripping conspiracy thriller. When a disgraced journalist turns to podcasting to salvage her career, she uncovers a strange conspiracy theory.

programme.title: Kingdoms Of Fire, Ice & Fairytales
programme.desc: Get up close and personal with the ice-covered landmass of Antarctica, the magical Black Forest of Germany, and the iconic Yellowstone of the USA, get up close and personal to these three world wonders.

programme.title: Flight 149: Hostage Of War
programme.desc: When Flight 149 landed in Kuwait, its passengers became pawns in Saddam's invasion, held as human shields. Decades later, survivors seek justice and the truth.

programme.title: Scent Of A Woman
programme.desc: Al Pacino gives an Oscar-winning performance in this riveting drama. A student takes a job minding a blind man. He soon realises that the man is anything but helpless.

programme.title: Rise Of The Guardians
programme.desc: Santa Claus, Jack Frost, the Easter Bunny, and the Sandman are heroes in this fantastic animated adventure. When an evil spirit threatens the world, these guardians must save the day.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: The gang returns for another crazy adventure. This time, their plane crash-lands, leaving them stranded in the middle of Africa, where Alex is reunited with his parents.

programme.title: Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir: The...
programme.desc: 'Miraculous Ladybug & Cat Noir: The Movie'. An animation based on the Miraculous franchise. Two teens transformed into superheroes join forces to protect their city from a villain.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: Michael Keaton stars as Batman in this slick, big-screen adaptation of the comic book hero. A corrupt businessman teams up with the evil Penguin and exacts terror on Gotham City.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg directs this sequel to the groundbreaking Oscar-winning film. A research team is taken to Island B to study the dinosaurs, but a great threat is approaching.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson leads a starry cast in this high-stakes seventh instalment. A team of skilled operatives seeks to extract dinosaur DNA for a medical breakthrough.

programme.title: M3gan
programme.desc: Chucky fans, stand up! A robotics engineer at a toy company builds a life-like doll that begins to take on a life of its own in this eye-opening sci-fi horror.

programme.title: Panama
programme.desc: This tumultuous political thriller stars Mel Gibson. While in Panama for an arms deal, a former Marine's mission becomes much more complicated as his life is at risk.

programme.title: The Surfer
programme.desc: Nicholas Cage's performance drives this psychological thriller. A father revisits his childhood beach with his son, but a clash with the locals pushes him to his edge.

programme.title: A Thousand And One
programme.desc: Entertainer Teyana Taylor gives her all to this gritty, heartbreaking drama about an ex-con mother struggling to raise her son after abducting him from the foster care system.

programme.title: Finnick
programme.desc: An animation about family and responsibility. Finnick is a young Finn who doesn't seem to care about making a home out of his house. But things change when a new family arrives.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out Of...
programme.desc: The Spongebob Movie: Sponge Out Of Water. A great SpongeBob film. SpongeBob and his enemy team up to retrieve the stolen, Krabby Patty formula.

programme.title: Bernard: Mission Mars
programme.desc: A funny, heartfelt space adventure animation for the family. An unlucky agent secretly infiltrates a Mars mission to catch a Martian monster but ends up befriending it.

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: This great family animated adventure is about an advanced canine and his adopted son, who endeavour to fix some complications caused by their time travelling.

programme.title: The Life Of Chuck
programme.desc: Tom Hiddleston headlines this life-affirming epic fantasy. The life of Charles Krantz unfolds across three stunning chapters, filled with mystery, celebration, and fantasy.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: A futuristic sci-fi epic helmed by Tom Cruise. A veteran assigned to extract Earth's remaining resources discovers a crashed spacecraft that will change everything he knew.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: This historical drama ties the loose ends of an award-winning show of the same name. It shows the lives of a family and its servants as they navigate through changes in society.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and Channing Tatum team up for this rom-com adventure. A romance novelist and her cover model get swept up in a kidnapping that lands them in a jungle adventure.

programme.title: The Best Man Holiday
programme.desc: Taye Diggs, Morris Chestnut and the crew return for the sequel to the hit film, The Best Man. But if they all want to get along, they must first settle old differences.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: A gripping survival thriller with religious elements. A group of plane crash survivors find themselves stranded and must fight for their survival.

programme.title: Skincare
programme.desc: A suspenseful, darkly comic thriller based on true events. A famed aesthetician's life and career begin to spiral when someone starts trying to destroy her reputation.
